tweetMedia.transcription: Kimberly Guilfoyle is the right person for dad and for our family. I will never accept Bettina Anderson as my mother. Kimberly has been by dad's side for seven years. She understands his career and, more importantly, the rhythm of our Trump family. She's a former prosecutor, a former Fox News anchor, and also served as finance chair for grandpa's campaign. She campaigned for grandpa and accompanied dad to events. She's gentle and patient with us kids, never overly eager to please, yet always reassuring. Grandpa has always trusted her and later nominated her as ambassador to Greece, which speaks volumes. She's long been one of us, family. Bettina is nothing like her. She's a Danish model and socialite. Her only connection to dad was a brief rumor at the Ambani wedding in India in 2025. Not even a formal relationship, let alone integration into our family. Her world is fashion parties and flashbulbs. It clashes completely with dad's political career and our family life. even if Aunt Ivanka approves of her I absolutely refuse to accept her as my mother
